newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Petrobras to sign gas deal with Comgas.
newsitem.headline: Petrobras to sign gas deal with Comgas.

text.p: Brazilian state oil giant Petrobras and Sao Paulo state gas firm Companhia de Gas do Estado de Sao Paulo (Comgas) are due to sign a deal on gas supply from the Bolivia-Brazil pipeline, Petrobras said.

Under the agreement, which is being signed in Sao Paulo, Comgas will receive 4 million cubic meters of Bolivian gas per day as of the end of 1998, Petrobras said in a statement. This amount is to increase gradually to 8.1 million cubic meters per day after eight years.

Construction of the 1,900-mile (3,000 km) Bolivia-Brazil gas pipeline, which links Bolivia's natural gas fields with Brazil's industrial heartland, is due to start by the end of this year or early 1997. The $1.8 billion project is due to come online late 1998.
Petrobras and Comgas are also signing a contract to increase the amount of Brazilian gas supplied to Comgas by 1.5 million cubic meters per day to 4.5 million cubic meters per day.
--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
